newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks seen moving higher on Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks seen moving higher on Wall Street.

text.p: Brokers and analysts said they expected to see the Hong Kong stock market move up sharply following Wall Street's strong performance.
"Most institutional brokers appear to have large buy orders, said one local broker."

The Hang Seng Index set a new all time closing high of 12,775.47 after rising 272 points on Wednesday. However, overnight the Hang Seng London Reference Index eased 34.39 points to 12,741.08 as some investors cautiously took profits.
